analysis: The trial crashed after consuming 500.92 GPU-seconds and returned no validation score. The supplied traceback only reports that train.py exited with status 1; it does not identify the underlying exception. Consequently, ensemble quality and complementarity remain unmeasured, and no improvement over the historical 0.4725 similarity or 0.5050 SASRec references is established. The trial-local working/training_error.log or subprocess output is needed to diagnose the failure. Exact score-agreement assertions across candidate chunks and permutations are a possible failure point because floating-point differences can change ranks, but this is unconfirmed.
code_summary: Independent two-expert ensemble trained sequentially on one GPU for all four categories. AttentiveSimilarity retains candidate-conditioned history attention, two causal context blocks, recency biases, item bias, and a gated sequential readout, trained with sampled cross-entropy and AdamW. SASRec uses 50-dimensional embeddings, two causal attention blocks, pointwise feedforward layers, and positive/negative BCE with Adam. Each expert selects checkpoints independently by validation HR@10, breaking ties with NDCG@10. Inference prepares each expert's chronological history suffix and averages normalized descending ranks over the complete candidate list, using item-ID tie-breaking and identical ranks for duplicate IDs. The exported predictor lazily reloads both checkpoints and preserves dataset routing. Training includes deadlines and predictor consistency checks; successful completion was not observed.
